app.name: Command Center
app.description: NOC event console with on-call teams and escalation via Workflows

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read configuration, incidents and the notification ledger

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Persist configuration, incidents and operator actions

scopes.name: state:app-states:delete
scopes.comment: Remove folded actions and deleted configuration

scopes.name: iam:users:read
scopes.comment: Pick on-call team members from tenant users

scopes.name: automation:workflows:read
scopes.comment: Show the engine and custom workflow status (Integrations → Workflows)

scopes.name: automation:workflows:run
scopes.comment: Run your Custom workflow integration once per notification

scopes.name: document:documents:read
scopes.comment: List notebooks to attach to war rooms

scopes.name: document:documents:write
scopes.comment: Create post-mortem notebooks from war rooms

scopes.name: credential-vault:entries:read
scopes.comment: Read provider secrets (Credential Vault) when sending notifications

actions.name: run-engine
actions.title: Run Command Center engine
actions.description: Runs one Command Center engine cycle: alerts, escalations, notifications.

actions.name: send-notification
actions.title: Send Command Center notification
actions.description: Sends one Command Center notification through a configured provider and records the result.
